sm115-1.name: Caterpie
sm115-1.description: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

sm115-2.name: Metapod
sm115-2.description: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

sm115-3.name: Butterfree
sm115-3.description: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

sm115-4.name: Paras
sm115-4.description: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

sm115-5.name: Scyther
sm115-5.description: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

attacks.name: Guillotine GX
attacks.effect: (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-7.name: Charmander
sm115-7.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

sm115-8.name: Charmeleon
sm115-8.description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz GX
attacks.effect: (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-10.name: Magmar
sm115-10.description: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

sm115-11.name: Psyduck
sm115-11.description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

sm115-12.name: Slowpoke
sm115-12.description: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

sm115-13.name: Staryu
sm115-13.description: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Star Stream
attacks.effect: Attach 2 Water Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump GX
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-15.name: Magikarp
sm115-15.description: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam GX
attacks.effect: (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-17.name: Lapras
sm115-17.description: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

sm115-18.name: Vaporeon
sm115-18.description: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

sm115-19.name: Pikachu
sm115-19.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

attacks.name: Spark Ball GX
attacks.effect: (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-21.name: Voltorb
sm115-21.description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

sm115-22.name: Electrode
sm115-22.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

attacks.name: Electroblast
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

sm115-23.name: Jolteon
sm115-23.description: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Wall
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

sm115-24.name: Zapdos
sm115-24.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

attacks.name: Hurricane Call
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX. Then, shuffle your deck.

sm115-25.name: Ekans
sm115-25.description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.

sm115-26.name: Ekans
sm115-26.description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

sm115-27.name: Arbok
sm115-27.description: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

abilities.name: Last Pattern
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent’s attack, discard 2 random cards from your opponent’s hand.

attacks.name: Rocket Tail
attacks.effect: If Jessie & James is in your discard pile, this attack does 80 more damage.

sm115-28.name: Koffing
sm115-28.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

sm115-29.name: Weezing
sm115-29.description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

abilities.name: Surrender Now
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is discarded with the effect of Jessie & James, you may have your opponent discard a card from their hand. (They discard that card after the effect of Jessie & James.)

sm115-30.name: Jynx
sm115-30.description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

attacks.name: Psycrush GX
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-32.name: Mew
sm115-32.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

sm115-33.name: Geodude
sm115-33.description: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

sm115-34.name: Graveler
sm115-34.description: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

attacks.name: Mudslide
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Fighting Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sm115-35.name: Golem
sm115-35.description: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 3 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Rocky Avalanche GX
attacks.effect: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-37.name: Cubone
sm115-37.description: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sm115-38.name: Clefairy
sm115-38.description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

sm115-39.name: Clefairy
sm115-39.description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

sm115-40.name: Clefable
sm115-40.description: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

sm115-41.name: Jigglypuff
sm115-41.description: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

attacks.name: Rolling Rush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Lovely Star GX
attacks.effect: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-43.name: Mr. Mime
sm115-43.description: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

attacks.name: Happy Mime
attacks.effect: Each player draws a card.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sky Legends GX
attacks.effect: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Fire, Water, and Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), this attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-45.name: Farfetch’d
sm115-45.description: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

sm115-46.name: Chansey
sm115-46.description: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.effect: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

sm115-47.name: Kangaskhan
sm115-47.description: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

attacks.name: Parental Fury
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

sm115-48.name: Eevee
sm115-48.description: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Spin Tackle
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

sm115-49.name: Eevee
sm115-49.description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

sm115-50.name: Snorlax
sm115-50.description: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

sm115-51.name: Bill’s Analysis
sm115-51.effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 Trainer cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

sm115-52.name: Blaine’s Last Stand
sm115-52.effect:
You can play this card only when it is the last card in your hand.

Draw 2 cards for each Fire Pokémon you have in play.

sm115-53.name: Brock’s Grit
sm115-53.effect: Shuffle 6 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

sm115-54.name: Brock’s Pewter City Gym
sm115-54.effect: Onix-GX (both yours and your opponent’s) take 40 less damage from the opponent’s attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

sm115-55.name: Brock’s Training
sm115-55.effect: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Geodude, Graveler, Golem, Onix-GX, Cubone, Rhyhorn, Rhydon, or Sudowoodo.

sm115-56.name: Erika’s Hospitality
sm115-56.effect:
You can play this card only if you have 4 or fewer other cards in your hand.

Draw a card for each of your opponent’s Pokémon in play.

sm115-57.name: Giovanni’s Exile
sm115-57.effect: Discard up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon that have no damage counters on them and all cards attached to them.

sm115-58.name: Jessie & James
sm115-58.effect: Each player discards 2 cards from their hand. Your opponent discards first.

sm115-59.name: Koga’s Trap
sm115-59.effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

sm115-60.name: Lt. Surge’s Strategy
sm115-60.effect:
You can play this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

During this turn, you can play 3 Supporter cards (including this card).

sm115-61.name: Misty’s Cerulean City Gym
sm115-61.effect: The attacks of Starmie-GX (both yours and your opponent’s) do 40 more damage to the opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sm115-62.name: Misty’s Determination
sm115-62.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

sm115-63.name: Misty’s Water Command
sm115-63.effect: Move any number of Water Energy from your Pokémon to your Psyduck, Horsea, Staryu, Starmie-GX, Magikarp, Gyarados, or Lapras in any way you like.

sm115-64.name: Pokémon Center Lady
sm115-64.effect: Heal 60 damage and remove all Special Conditions from 1 of your Pokémon.

sm115-65.name: Sabrina’s Suggestion
sm115-65.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this card.

attacks.effect: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Fire, Water, and Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), this attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

sm115-67.effect: Discard up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon that have no damage counters on them and all cards attached to them.

sm115-68.name: Jessie & James
sm115-68.effect: Each player discards 2 cards from their hand. Your opponent discards first.
